verdict.rationale: sevDesk's docs show it prepares a cash-basis income statement (a P&L), a trial balance, and a real-time BWA business analysis, so the P&L part of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows a balance sheet or a cash-flow statement; the petty-cash 'cash report' is a different thing. Missing for 10: balance sheet generation, cash-flow statement generation, documented arbitrary-period selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: sevdesk prepares a cash-basis income statement from your income and expenses.
Create a real-time business analysis report (BWA) based on current data from your digital bookkeeping in sevdesk.
The trial balance gives you a detailed view of your accounts and journal entries.
